text_block_list.text:
———— On a day just before the 
Autumn Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff, huff ——
choice_data_list: Alright, let's finish up here today…!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Mhm, got it. I've gotta say though —— Haha, I'm completely spent…!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Still, for you to be able to change your 
trajectory in such a short amount of 
time, it's nothing short of impressive…!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Well that's because I'm borrowing some 
of your power too y'know. I can't take 
this task half-heartedly.

Stay Gold was making her final adjustments 
with Bubble Gum who has experienced the 
Autumn Tenno Sho during her Classics era.

Today marks the final frantic push before 
the actual day, all to ensure that Stay Gold 
will have more than enough battle power. 
Though……

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
……Even from how I see it, Suzuka's 
performance today was overwhelming, 
to the point where she could even be 
considered the top of this generation.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Right? You've summed it up pretty well.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
But, you've gone way past what I thought a 
Classics horse girl could be. There's no way 
you can't stand head to head against her.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna be personally cheering you on, 
since you were able to show me such a 
great Satsuki Sho and Japan Derby.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Haha, well I hope I can meet those expectations of yours.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
But, look forward to it alright. I'm gonna 
make this a race you can't peel your 
eyes away from.

————And then, it was the day of the 
Autumn Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Gee everyone, to think that you'd all go 
to the trouble of making your way here.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Fufu, it is such a shame that we are not together for the Kikuka Sho, but I would like to give you all my support～

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
……Being unable to see you run in the 
Kikuka Sho is truly vexing, but this 
decision is certainly very much like 
something you would choose to do.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I truly wish that you fully exhibit the power 
forged under our discipline to those in the 
Senior year, and to Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Elegant Chestnut-Haired Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Miss Stego, I shall be praying for your 
success, and please, may your shield 
shine with glory…!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
For all the trouble I've caused, I'll be 
properly paying it all back today. Watch 
closely alright?
Su - Te - Go～!!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: What Do You Mean By This～!!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
That… That passionate vow we had～!!! 
For our showdown at the Kikuka Sho～!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Well about that, what do I say… I'm really 
quite sorry about that. Fate's wheels have 
shifted some things y'see.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Regardless, there will definitely be another 
chance to run with you. So let's have our 
showdown once that time comes.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Mark your words alright!? This one is a 
surefire promise!! Otherwise you'll be 
chugging ten million curses from me!!!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Wahaha. That's a tad frightening.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Though, you sure it's alright to not be 
visiting Suzuka?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Ah, about that… Suzuka ——

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
……"I would like to focus by myself please", 
is what she said to me.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
The mood around her made it very hard 
to continue talking ——

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
……Stego, what do you think happened 
to Suzuka?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
All she has been doing lately is just staring 
off into the distance… And the way she's 
been racing has just been so intense ——

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
It's almost as if… her soul has been 
whisked away by some greater thing.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
……Y'know, you've got some pretty 
keen senses on you.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
…Don't you worry about Suzuka. I want 
you to pray for her better fortunes while 
you watch the race.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
That will end up being the best thing we 
can do for her.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Stego……

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: I want you to enjoy today's race too.
choice_data_list: You'll make the ultimate finish today
You'll make the ultimate finish today

text_block_list.text:
I've done everything I could possibly do, 
and Stay Gold has answered everything. 
All that is left is to win this thing.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: I'm going to have the greatest time of my life.
(Waaaaaaaaaーーーーーー!!)

text_block_list.name: Suzuka Fan A
text_block_list.text: Suzukaaa! Go outrun all of themmm!

text_block_list.name: Suzuka Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I want to see that crazy run of yours 
againnn!! Do your besttt!!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ……Her heart isn't here huh.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
(What now, it's…? My "memories", they're 
going haywire ——)

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
(The countless number of emotions that 
spiralled throughout that day… They're 
overflowing ——)

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ————Could you pipe down.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
……The one who is running in this race 
today is me. This race shall be ours to run.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: So be quiet… And watch carefully.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Because for us… We run for the joy of 
running.
